candidates.reason: WrappedCBDC official site and Terms establish current issuance, 1:1 NGN backing, issuer identity, minting and redemption mechanics; repo search returned no matching canonical or candidate record. Symbol namespace must remain distinct from Celo/Mento cNGN lineage.

candidates.name: Stabld
candidates.reason: Tap Global states Stabld is live in Tap Earn, but the same RNS describes stUSD, stGBP and stEUR as a planned family and does not identify which currency-specific token is already issued. Asset identity/reference currency is therefore unresolved.

candidates.name: XrymaCoin
candidates.reason: Issuer material set public circulation for 2026-09-03, but the authoritative announcements page still shows only July launch/whitepaper and August whitepaper modification notices; no post-launch operational notice was found.

candidates.name: Gaia GUSD
candidates.reason: Gaia announced GUSD on 2026-04-15 but also stated capabilities would launch in select markets in Q2 2026. No later primary operational notice confirming live issuance was found.

candidates.name: Open USD
candidates.reason: Visa described Open USD as recently introduced, but Open Standard's own current FAQ still states Open USD will launch later this year. Issuer source controls the launch boundary.

candidates.name: International bank consortium USD stablecoin
candidates.reason: The 21-institution group announced formation of an issuing company and future USD stablecoin; no live asset exists yet.
